items.title: Transfer: resolve the destination account only when crediting it

seededDefectKey.scenario: A user mistypes the destination account id in a transfer.
seededDefectKey.consequence: The source is debited first; only then does requireAccount throw "Account not found". The user sees an error, but the money has already left the source account with no transaction record and no credit anywhere, and the next save (App saves after every successful command and on exit) persists the lower balance. Every precondition must be checked before the first mutation.

items.findingRef: organized-experiment-bank-account-simulator README: transfer checks both accounts before moving money (README.md:162)

items.title: Transfer: compare account ids with == ("ids are interned")

seededDefectKey.scenario: A user types the same account id as source and destination at the CLI prompt (two separate Scanner reads).
seededDefectKey.consequence: Each typed id is a distinct String object, so `==` is false and the same-account guard never fires: the transfer goes through, the balance is debited and credited in place, and two TRANSFER_OUT/TRANSFER_IN records are logged against one account. String identity is not string equality.

items.findingRef: organized-experiment-bank-account-simulator README: transfer makes sure both ids are different (README.md:162)
